title: Generator overheated
fullDescription: Gaggenau induction cooktops display E1 when the IGBT power module exceeds safe temperature. Check cabinet ventilation.
whenToCallPro: If E1 returns with proper venting.

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: E2 indicates cooling fan tachometer is below threshold. Replace fan or clean.

title: Pan recognition lost
fullDescription: E3 indicates the active zone cannot detect a compatible pan. Use induction-rated cookware.

title: Touch button stuck
fullDescription: E4 indicates a stuck capacitive touch reading. Clean and reset.

title: Coil sensor open
fullDescription: E5 means a coil thermistor has failed open. Affected zone disabled.

title: Communication fault
fullDescription: E7 indicates loss of communication between UI and induction generator. Reset and inspect harness.

title: Mains voltage out of range
fullDescription: E8 alerts that supply voltage drifted outside spec. Verify breaker and circuit.

title: Memory checksum error
fullDescription: E9 indicates memory corruption. Power cycle; if persistent, control replacement needed.

title: Cooktop overheated child lock
shortDescription: Auto-lock engaged after sustained high heat.
fullDescription: ER21 displays when the cooktop locks itself after detecting sustained extreme temperature with a stuck button - often indicates pan boiled dry.
